premises.statement: Incoming phone-number friendly names that pass validation after trimming should be output trimmed rather than preserved as originally supplied.
premises.evidence_of_dependence: when regexp_matches(trim(friendly_name), '^[A-Za-z0-9\s._-]*$') and length(trim(friendly_name)) <= 100 then trim(friendly_name)
premises.alternative: The table-specific contract validates "TRIM(friendly_name) RLIKE '^[A-Za-z0-9\\s._-]*$' AND LENGTH(TRIM(friendly_name)) <= 100" with "on_failure: nullify_field"; this also permits validating the trimmed value while retaining the original value when valid.
premises.reason: The validation does not explicitly require changing valid labels, so this interpretation affects whitespace in retained names.
